findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/EllipticCurve/Affine/Point.lean:188 `lemma map_mk (f : R →+* S) (x : R[X][Y]) : map W' f (mk W' x) = mk (W'.map f) (x.map <| mapRingHom f)`; Point.lean:111 `noncomputable abbrev mk : R[X][Y] →+* W'.CoordinateRing`. The new file exposes only `coordinateRingGaloisAction_of` (Galois.lean:147, `p : K[X]`) and `_root` (Galois.lean:137); no `_mk`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem coordinateRingGaloisAction_mk (σ : K ≃ₐ[F] K) (p : K[X][Y]) : coordinateRingGaloisAction W σ (CoordinateRing.mk _ p) = CoordinateRing.mk _ (p.map (mapRingHom σ))`, mirroring `CoordinateRing.map_mk`, and the function-field corollary through `functionFieldGaloisAction_algebraMap_coordinateRing` (the analogue of `translation_apply_mk`).
findings.issue: The characteristic API for `coordinateRingGaloisAction` stops at the two generators (`_of` for `p : K[X]`, `_root`). There is no rule for a general element `CoordinateRing.mk _ p` with `p : K[X][Y]`, which is how every other coordinate-ring lemma in scope presents elements (Mathlib `WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.map_mk`, this repo's `CoordinateRing.map_XClass`/`map_YClass`, `translation_apply_mk`). A consumer holding `mk _ p` must re-derive the ring-hom equality via `AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext` and `RingHom.congr_fun` — exactly the 50-line pattern this file itself repeats at lines 294-345 — instead of rewriting.

findings.evidence: Galois.lean:72-107 (`@[simp] private theorem coordinateRingGaloisEquiv_*`) versus Galois.lean:126-153 (`@[simp] theorem coordinateRingGaloisAction_*`), whose bodies are `change coordinateRingGaloisEquiv W σ ... = _; exact coordinateRingGaloisEquiv_* ...`.
findings.fix: Drop `@[simp]` from the three private lemmas and pass them explicitly in the two proofs that need them (`coordinateRingGaloisAction.map_one'`/`map_mul'`, lines 114-123, currently bare `simp`); keep `@[simp]` only on the public `coordinateRingGaloisAction_algebraMap`/`_root`/`_of`.
findings.issue: `coordinateRingGaloisEquiv_algebraMap` (line 72), `coordinateRingGaloisEquiv_root` (line 94) and `coordinateRingGaloisEquiv_of` (line 102) are `private` yet `@[simp]`. Their LHS mentions the private `coordinateRingGaloisEquiv`, which no downstream goal can contain, and each is a verbatim duplicate of the public `coordinateRingGaloisAction_*` rule (the public proofs are `change ...; exact ...`, so the two are the same rewrite up to a def simp will not unfold). The annotations are dead weight in the default simp set.

summary: The new Galois action lacks the `mk`-level computation rule that Mathlib's `CoordinateRing.map_mk` and this repo's `translation_apply_mk` both provide, so a general regular function cannot be pushed through the action without redoing the `AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext` argument by hand. Three private lemmas also carry dead `@[simp]` annotations duplicating their public counterparts.
